unresolved: The source has no figures and no supplements, so no visual, figure-EHR, privacy or supplement sidecars apply.
Table 1 is a one-row-per-patient summary, not a serial per-patient table, so no measurement series is recorded.
Two further patients of the earlier seven-patient series lacked follow-up and are described only in one sentence each; they are not roster patients.
Cohort statements (inclusion criteria such as positive Mantoux/TST, median follow-up, counts of recurrences, anti-TNF effectiveness, Table 2 literature) are not copied to individuals.
Table 1 prints best corrected visual acuity as bare decimals without a stated scale or unit.
The authors hedge that recurrences may not signify true tubercular uveitis; the TBU label is recorded with verification unknown.

Reinfection is not recorded per patient: the discussion says "in none of the cases was there a suspicion of reinfection based on the clinical history and absence of other organ involvement" but also "it can be difficult to exclude a reinfection with TB even after a thorough examination"; no suspicion is not an assertion that reinfection was absent. The sentence that no alternative systemic disease or infection was identified is scoped to recurrent episodes and repeats the case-level statements, so it is not copied either.

key_findings: Five Table 1 cases, each with a Results Case N paragraph; roster 5 complete (b00002).

Methods all-patient statements (ATT 2HRZE/4HRE, HIV not positive, no side effects or non-compliance) and the b00031 "In all cases" sentence explicitly cover all five; the Mantoux/TST inclusion criterion is a cohort diagnostic basis and is not copied.

p1 "still used" mycophenolate mofetil and dexamethasone "Until the end of the follow-up" places use at the latest described time, so action current is allowed; last-visit table treatments are administered; "Other medication" items are unknown.
